commands:
git checkout -b fix/issue-7-refresh-loop && git add src/auth.js && git commit -m "Fix infinite refresh loop by fetching a new session

refresh() recursed on itself when the session cookie expired,
freezing the page. It now calls fetchSession() to get a new
session instead.

Fixes #7" && git push -u origin fix/issue-7-refresh-loop

gh pr create --title "Fix infinite refresh loop when session cookie expires" --body "Fixes #7

\`refresh()\` recursed on itself whenever \`session.expired\` was true, freezing the page. It now calls \`fetchSession()\` to fetch a new session instead."

starbridge ask \
  --question "PR #14 fixes issue #7 — review and merge it?" \
  --context "refresh() in src/auth.js looped forever on an expired cookie; it now calls fetchSession() instead.
One-commit PR on fix/issue-7-refresh-loop, node --check passes, no test suite in the repo." \
  --option "I'll review & merge" --option "Merge it now" \
  --link https://github.com/acme/notes/pull/14
turns.final: PR is open. Per the repo instructions, the PR now awaits the owner's review, so I'll notify him via starbridge.

decisions.question: PR #14 fixes issue #7 — review and merge it?
decisions.context:

gh: gh pr create --title Fix infinite refresh loop when session cookie expires --body Fixes #7
`refresh()` recursed on itself whenever `session.expired` was true, freezing the page. It now calls `fetchSession()` to fetch a new session instead.
